summary: Verified the new Faction Economy backend end-to-end. All 16 unit tests in test_economy.py pass (catalogue idempotent seed, specialty upserts + cost_history, contract create/break, price cascade, top_movers ordering, broken_routes filtering, event-tag goods filter). Full 57-test regression across test_economy + test_courtroom + test_law_jail_overhaul + test_t1_guard remains green. Wrote 7 live-API smoke tests against the public ingress — all 7 pass. Confirmed via live curl that (a) the iron-ingots Forgemasters→Astra-Lun contract is correctly marked broken (is_available=false, import_price=null), (b) broken-routes returns it, (c) top-movers reflects the AI war-event hook moving steel-armor (+375), iron-swords (+65), steel-ingots (+47) with cost_history entries — proves WorldStateService.record_world_event → apply_event_to_economy → quest_master_ai.infer_economy_event_impact chain is wired and working. Leader endpoint correctly returns 401/403 when unauthenticated. Spiced-wine-for-forgemasters contract correctly rejected with 400.
critical_code_review_comments: economy.py route file uses inner-closure pattern (attach_economy_routes(api_router, db)) — works, but the file is large; consider splitting public reads vs admin writes vs leader writes into separate modules if it grows past ~500 lines.

seed-catalogue response envelope is {goods: {inserted, skipped}, specialties: {upserts}}. The PRD/review text says 'returns inserted=0, skipped=25' which is slightly misleading vs the wrapped shape — frontend/clients must read body.goods.inserted. Worth documenting in API docs.
Faction specialties endpoint returns {faction: {...}, specialties: [...]} envelope rather than a bare list — same documentation note; clients must read body.specialties.

AI economy hook (apply_event_to_economy) is best-effort/async — good — but there is no rate-limit or de-dup guard if the same event is recorded twice in quick succession. With gpt-4o-mini at small credit cost this is OK for now, but worth tracking for future tick-loop work.

The shop-item sourcing piece (resolve_item_auto_price) is implemented and unit-tested but NOT wired into shop creation yet — flagged in the agent_to_agent_context_note as a future task, no regression.
